## Provider interface

A provider as `g.provider()` returns it, typed by its id, its entity, its raw fields `R` and its  derived fields `D`<!-- -->: routes name it, and a run asked for it as itself types its rows.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface Provider<Id extends string, N extends string, R extends object, D, Meta> extends ProviderDef<Meta> 
```
**Extends:** [ProviderDef](./hopgraph.providerdef.md)<!-- -->&lt;Meta&gt;
